crossRefs.note: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
The men who have been mentioned by name rose up and took the captives, and with the plunder clothed all who were naked…
Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you…
I was naked, and you clothed me. I was sick, and you visited me. I was in prison, and you came to me.’
I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit…
He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”
Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him…
and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs…
My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

translations.web: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;
